text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, apixaban is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 131 units with 15 days of supply at 8.7 units per day. Corvale General holds 274 units with 26 days of supply at 10.5 units per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show apixaban is not listed as in shortage. The Amneal-labeled product (NDC 00115172203) identifies MSN Laboratories Private Limited in Telangana, India as the manufacturing plant. That plant does not appear in FDA's inspection classification records.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. No shortage exists per FDA. Alternative suppliers are available but none have verifiable manufacturing plant information in FDA records.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue current purchasing from existing contracted wholesalers; buyer approves.
2. Evaluate the five ranked alternative suppliers (A-S Medication Solutions, Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee LLC, Cardinal Health 107 LLC, E.R. Squibb & Sons LLC, Indoco Remedies Limited) for contract addition; buyer and P&T committee approve.
3. Request manufacturing plant details from each alternative supplier before committing volume; buyer approves.
4. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; buyer approves.

Not recommended: Switching supply sources based solely on price without confirmed plant inspection status. Initiating allocation or conservation protocols while days on hand exceed 14 days at both sites.
